criteria.statement: The domain package exposes power observation telemetry and advisory power recommendation contracts using continuity modes.
The orchestrator stores the latest power observation per worker and returns defensive copies to callers.
Low UPS runtime recommends emergency mode for non-critical services while preserving critical services unless another signal recommends degraded mode.
Low battery recommends degraded mode and critical thermal state recommends degraded mode only for compute-heavy services.
All power-aware recommendations remain advisory with AutoExecute false and deterministic service ordering.
